books.title: The Goal
books.blurb: A plant manager has three months to save his factory. A business novel about finding the one thing that holds a whole system back.
books.hook: Your boss is parked in your spot. Before your first coffee, your factory has 90 days to live.

books.title: A Study in Scarlet
books.blurb: The first Sherlock Holmes story: a doctor back from war, a strange new flatmate, and a murder in an empty London house.
books.hook: A dead man in an empty house, a word scrawled in blood, and a stranger who reads your past at a glance.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.blurb: Five sisters, one proud stranger and a first impression that turns out to be wrong.
books.hook: He insults her at a dance. She spends the next year proving him wrong.

books.title: The Art of War
books.blurb: Thirteen short chapters on winning, written 2,500 years ago and still read by generals and CEOs.
books.hook: The best way to win a war is to never have to fight it.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.blurb: A young scientist gives life to a creature and then abandons it, with consequences that follow him across Europe.
books.hook: He built a man out of the dead. Then he ran from what he made.
